message: test(items): isolate bulk fixtures and exercise native quantity editing
purpose: Keep every large-stack, conservation, replay and native-layout assertion. The catalog currently caps stacks at 99. A cloned fixture catalog with a 999-cap copper ore tests bulk support without changing production capacities. Native key events test quantity edits instead of relying on a programmatic Text assignment to emit a user-edit signal. Use distinct labels for base armor and bonus armor.
